list.label: Carte
list.query: select coalesce(nom, appareil) as __text, appareil as __value from caravane_cartes order by 1
list.definition: select coalesce(nom, appareil) as __text, appareil as __value from caravane_cartes order by 1

list.name: grandeur
list.label: Grandeur
list.query:
select libelle || coalesce(' (' || unite || ')', '') as __text, code as __value
from caravane_grandeurs g
where exists (select 1 from caravane_releves r where r.valeurs ? g.code)
order by ordre

targets.rawSql:
select distinct on (appareil, grandeur)
  nom || ' · ' || libelle || coalesce(' (' || unite || ')', '') as "grandeur", valeur
from caravane_series
where appareil in ($carte) and grandeur in ($grandeur)
order by appareil, grandeur, horodatage desc

select coalesce(k.nom, r.appareil) as carte, extract(epoch from max(r.horodatage)) * 1000 as "dernier relevé"
from caravane_releves r left join caravane_cartes k using (appareil)
where r.appareil in ($carte)
group by 1

panels.title: ${grandeur:text}

targets.rawSql:
with plage as (select $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz as d),
resolution as (
  select case when d <= interval '7 days' then 'brut'
              when d <= interval '90 days' then 'heure' else 'jour' end as r,
         case when d <= interval '7 days' then interval '1 hour'
              when d <= interval '90 days' then interval '3 hours' else interval '2 days' end as trou
  from plage),
points as (
  select s.horodatage as time, s.nom as metric, s.valeur as value
  from caravane_series s, resolution
  where resolution.r = 'brut'
    and s.appareil in ($carte) and s.grandeur = '$grandeur' and $__timeFilter(s.horodatage)
  union all
  select a.debut, coalesce(k.nom, a.appareil) || m.suffixe,
         case m.suffixe when '' then a.moyenne when ' · min' then a.mini else a.maxi end
  from caravane_agregats a
  left join caravane_cartes k using (appareil)
  cross join resolution
  cross join (values (''), (' · min'), (' · max')) m(suffixe)
  where a.periode = resolution.r
    and a.appareil in ($carte) and a.grandeur = '$grandeur' and $__timeFilter(a.debut)),
trous as (
  select p.time + interval '1 second' as time, p.metric, null::double precision as value
  from (select time, metric, lead(time) over (partition by metric order by time) as suivant from points) p,
       resolution
  where p.suivant - p.time > resolution.trou)
select * from points
union all
select * from trous
order by 1

panels.description: Jusqu'à 7 jours : chaque relevé. Jusqu'à 90 jours : moyenne horaire. Au-delà : moyenne journalière. En vue agrégée, minimum et maximum de la tranche en pointillés.

targets.rawSql:
select r.horodatage as time, coalesce(k.nom, r.appareil) as metric,
  case when r.secteur then 1 else 0 end as value
from caravane_releves r left join caravane_cartes k using (appareil)
where r.appareil in ($carte) and r.secteur is not null and $__timeFilter(r.horodatage)
order by 1

select r.horodatage as "heure", coalesce(k.nom, r.appareil) as "carte", r.releve_id as "n°", r.source,
  case when r.secteur then 'secteur' else 'batterie' end as "alim.",
  r.valeurs::text as "valeurs", r.recu_le as "reçu le"
from caravane_releves r left join caravane_cartes k using (appareil)
where r.appareil in ($carte) and $__timeFilter(r.horodatage)
order by 1 desc
limit 200

select k.recu_le as "reçu le", coalesce(nullif(k.config->>'nom', ''), k.appareil) as "carte",
  k.evenement as "événement", k.config->>'cause' as "cause", k.config->>'firmware' as "firmware",
  k.config->>'comm' as "comm.", (k.config->>'releve_s')::int / 60 as "relevé (min)",
  round((k.config->'etat'->>'vbat_mv')::numeric / 1000, 2) as "LiPo (V)",
  case (k.config->'etat'->>'secteur')::boolean when true then 'secteur' when false then 'batterie' end as "alim.",
  (k.config->'etat'->>'wifi_rssi')::int as "Wi-Fi (dBm)",
  (k.config->'etat'->>'temp_puce_c')::numeric as "puce (°C)",
  (select string_agg(e.key || ' ×' || (e.value->>'pente') || ' ' || (e.value->>'decalage'), ', ' order by e.key)
     from jsonb_each(k.config->'etalonnage') e
    where (e.value->>'pente')::float <> 1 or (e.value->>'decalage')::float <> 0) as "étalonnage (≠ défaut)"
from caravane_config k
where k.appareil in ($carte) and $__timeFilter(k.recu_le)
order by k.recu_le desc
limit 100

target.rawSql:
select recu_le as time, coalesce(nullif(config->>'nom', ''), appareil) || ' : ' || evenement as text
from caravane_config
where appareil in ($carte) and evenement <> 'periodique' and $__timeFilter(recu_le)
